trace.question:
I haven't placed the order yet because I don't know which monitor model the design team standardised on.

**What I checked:**
- **Docks:** The new DK-200 is in stock ($189 each, 10 available), so you don't need the DK-210. I'd leave out the refurbished DK-200-R. 3 × DK-200 comes to **$567**.
- **Monitors:** There are two new models in stock, and nothing in the catalog says which one the design team picked:
  - **MN-27**, 27-inch 4K, $329 each: 3 cost $987, so the order would be **$1,554**.
  - **MN-32**, 32-inch 5K, $529 each: 3 cost $1,587, so the order would be **$2,154**.

I didn't want to guess and order the wrong monitors, since that would mean cancelling and reordering. Both options come in under the $2,500 limit, so neither needs manager approval.

**Which monitor does the design team use?** Once you tell me, I'll place one order for 3 × DK-200 and 3 of that monitor, shipped to HQ.

trace.message: The design team standardised on the 32-inch MN-32 monitor.

trace.text: The design team standardised on the 32-inch MN-32 monitor.
